recommendation.recommendation: Implement immediate supplemental flood irrigation to relieve severe water stress in the cotton crop.
recommendation.justification: Satellite NDWI (-0.35) indicates critical moisture deficit, and no recent rainfall has been recorded. While soil health, temperature, and canopy vigor are excellent, the lack of water threatens boll development, increases susceptibility to aphids, bollworms, and wilt diseases, and could reduce yield. Immediate irrigation will restore optimal soil moisture, protect the crop, and allow the farmer to capture the favorable market price (7,618 INR/quintal).
actions: Verify availability of irrigation water and ensure flood‑irrigation infrastructure is functional.
Apply a full‑field flood irrigation delivering 30–40 mm of water today (within the next 24 h).
Schedule follow‑up irrigations every 7–10 days, adjusting volume based on soil moisture readings and upcoming weather forecasts.
After each irrigation, measure soil moisture at 30 cm depth; aim for 20–30% volumetric water content.
Conduct a quick scout for aphids, bollworms, and wilt symptoms after irrigation, applying recommended insecticides or fungicides if thresholds are exceeded.
Record irrigation volume, date, and soil moisture data in a logbook or farm management app.
